studies.title: Paper
studies.caption: Cai Lun reports a method of making paper from bark, hemp and rags to the Han court.
studies.prompt: Close workshop view in Han Luoyang about105CE: a papermaker lifts a rectangular bamboo screen holding wet fiber pulp above a shallow vat; dripping water, pale sheets drying nearby, bark and hemp bundles. Focus skilled hands and material transformation, no printing press or modern rollers.
